create_PyRobotNoisyActuationSpec: create a PyRobotNoisyActuationSpec with robot LoCoBot and ILQR controller for noisy actuation
use_PyrobotNoisyMoveForward: use PyrobotNoisyMoveForward to move a scene node forward with PyRobot noise applied
use_PyrobotNoisyMoveBackward: use PyrobotNoisyMoveBackward to move a scene node backward with PyRobot noise applied
use_PyrobotNoisyTurnLeft: use PyrobotNoisyTurnLeft to rotate a scene node left with PyRobot noise applied
use_PyrobotNoisyTurnRight: use PyrobotNoisyTurnRight to rotate a scene node right with PyRobot noise applied
